name: 6-EAPB
summary: A rare entactogen benzofuran structurally related to MDMA and 6-APB. It is reported to be weaker in effects. Pharmacological knowledge on this drug is limited. The drug is suspected to be a monoamine releaser, monoamine reuptake inhibitor or both.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 6-EAPB is a potent monoamine reuptake inhibitor. It shows very low potency as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist.

uses.en: It has been sold online as a designer drug. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它曾在網路上作為設計師藥物販售，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它曾在网络上作为设计师药物贩售，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: It is one of a family built on the benzofuran ring, where MDMA's two-oxygen bridge is replaced by a single oxygen inside a five-membered ring.
fact.zh: 它屬於以苯并呋喃環為基礎的一個家族；在這個家族中，MDMA含兩個氧的橋被五元環內的單一個氧取代。
fact.zhHans: 它属于以苯并呋喃环为基础的一个家族；在这个家族中，MDMA含两个氧的桥被五元环内的单一个氧取代。
